SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Oddish as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, short length, wide width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, small size, level outer corners, close-set; fine soft arches; rounded soft tip nose; small mouth.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free; the armor's outline stays slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

MECHA SILHOUETTE: light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.

TYPE EFFECTS: One open hand conjuring a fresh green glow amid drifting leaves and pollen sparks. A violet-and-acid-green toxic glow with bubbling drips pulses along her armor seams and joints. Small sprouting leaves and moss spread over the floor beneath her boots.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face. Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
